test_intent: Verifies that removing a suspicious user with userId=0 gracefully returns false and IsSuspicious returns false.
reason: Edge case test for userId=0 on RemoveSuspicious. Low production value since Telegram never produces zero user IDs, but verifies the storage handles the edge case gracefully without throwing. Simple, no fragile infrastructure. Consistent with keeping zero/negative userId edge cases in the same test class (see batch-0103 AddSuspiciousUser variants).

test_intent: Verifies that removing a suspicious user with a negative userId gracefully returns false and IsSuspicious returns false.
reason: Edge case test for negative userId on RemoveSuspicious. Low production value since Telegram user IDs are always positive. Same defensive pattern as zero userId variant. Simple, no fragile infrastructure. Consistent with keeping negative userId edge cases in the same test class.

test_intent: Verifies that IsSuspicious returns true for a user that was previously added to the storage.
reason: Core functionality test for the suspicious users storage lookup. Adds a user then asserts IsSuspicious returns true. Clean unit test with meaningful state assertion at the correct seam. No mocks, no fragile infrastructure. Tests the fundamental add-then-query contract of the storage.

test_intent: Verifies that IsSuspicious returns false for a user that was never added to the storage.
reason: Core negative-case test for the suspicious users storage lookup. Asserts IsSuspicious returns false for a user that does not exist. Complements the ExistingUser test. Clean unit test with meaningful state assertion. No mocks, no fragile infrastructure.

test_intent: Verifies that IsSuspicious returns false when queried with userId=0.
reason: Edge case test for userId=0 on IsSuspicious lookup. Low production value since Telegram never produces zero user IDs. Simple defensive check with meaningful assertion. No fragile infrastructure. Consistent with keeping zero userId edge cases in the same test class.

test_intent: Verifies that IsSuspicious returns false when queried with a negative userId.
reason: Edge case test for negative userId on IsSuspicious lookup. Low production value since Telegram user IDs are always positive. Same defensive pattern as zero userId variant. Simple, no fragile infrastructure. Consistent with keeping negative userId edge cases in the same test class.

test_intent: Verifies that after adding and then removing a suspicious user, IsSuspicious returns false, confirming removal is effective.
reason: Tests the add-then-remove-then-query lifecycle of the suspicious users storage. Verifies that RemoveSuspicious actually clears the user so IsSuspicious returns false afterward. test_intent: Verifies that GetAiDetectUsers returns an empty collection when no suspicious users are in storage.
reason: Core negative-case test for GetAiDetectUsers. Asserts empty collection from empty storage. Clean unit test with meaningful state assertion (Is.Empty). No mocks, no fragile infrastructure. Tests the base case of the retrieval method.

test_intent: Verifies that GetAiDetectUsers returns all suspicious users that were added to storage, checking both count and membership.
reason: Core positive-case test for GetAiDetectUsers with multiple users. Asserts both count (2) and membership (Does.Contain for each user tuple). Stronger assertion than most tests in this class. Clean unit test at the correct seam. No mocks, no fragile infrastructure. Complements the EmptyStorage test.
